name: bueromarkt-scraper
description: Node scraper for bueromarkt-ag.de (Puppeteer + ProxyRack, Autodoc-style)

scripts.seed-sample: cp urls.sample.json urls.json && echo 'using sample product URLs'
scripts.start-pp: USE_PROXY=1 HEADLESS=0 HIDE_CHROME=1 THREADS=4 BLOCK_TYPES= DELAY_MS=400 node puppeteer_worker.js
scripts.start-pp-direct: USE_PROXY=0 HEADLESS=0 HIDE_CHROME=1 THREADS=10 BLOCK_TYPES= DELAY_MS=400 node puppeteer_worker.js
scripts.start-pp-direct-2: USE_PROXY=0 HEADLESS=0 HIDE_CHROME=1 THREADS=10 BLOCK_TYPES= DELAY_MS=400 PROFILE=/tmp/bueromarkt-pp-profile-2 node puppeteer_worker.js
scripts.start-pp-visible: USE_PROXY=0 HEADLESS=0 HIDE_CHROME=0 THREADS=10 BLOCK_TYPES= DELAY_MS=400 node puppeteer_worker.js
scripts.start-pp-headless: USE_PROXY=0 HEADLESS=1 THREADS=4 BLOCK_TYPES= DELAY_MS=400 node puppeteer_worker.js
scripts.start-pp-fast: HEADLESS=1 THREADS=4 PAGE_CONCURRENCY=2 BLOCK_TYPES=image,font DELAY_MS=200 node puppeteer_worker.js
